summary: Along Airport (IXV/VEAN) is a medium-sized regional airport serving Along, the headquarters of West Siang district in Arunachal Pradesh, one of India's most remote northeastern states. The airport provides a vital air link to a mountainous, strategically important region that borders China, Bhutan, and Myanmar. It primarily handles short-haul domestic flights connecting the far-flung town to larger hubs in northeast India.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines operate from Along Airport?
A: Small regional carriers such as Pawan Hans and occasional scheduled services by Alliance Air and others operate flights, though schedules and operators change frequently due to weather and demand in the region.

Q: What is the nearest major city to Along Airport?
A: Guwahati in Assam is the nearest major metropolitan hub, roughly 350 km away, and serves as the primary connecting gateway for travelers heading to Along.

Q: When is the best time to fly into Along Airport?
A: The dry months from October to April are most reliable for flights, as the monsoon season from June to September frequently causes cancellations due to poor visibility and heavy rainfall.

Q: Does Along Airport have night landing facilities?
A: No, the airport operates only during daylight hours (VFR conditions), so all flights are scheduled around sunrise and sunset times.
transport_tips: The airport is located just a few kilometers from Along town center, and local taxis and shared jeeps are typically available to meet arriving flights, though it's wise to pre-arrange transport given the limited number of vehicles. Roads connecting Along to other parts of Arunachal Pradesh and Assam are mountainous and slow, so allow extra travel time if continuing overland. Helicopter services operated by Pawan Hans often serve as an alternative when road or runway conditions are unfavorable.
local_tip: Carry warm clothing even in summer—Along sits at a relatively high elevation in the Eastern Himalayas, and temperatures can drop sharply in the evenings, especially outside the peak monsoon months.
